name: desktop-feature-plan-actions
goal: Allow the selected local desktop project to select and approve an exact feature plan and queue its tasks.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Use local-only transport, exact project and source revision, current plan digest, readiness validation and idempotent task admission. Keep per-design approval separate and never start an unqualified provider. Verify valid, stale, foreign and remote-device cases.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Added local-only project-bound plan selection and approval with readiness-checked exact task admission. Chat controls and automatic worker scheduling remain outside this slice.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Desktop socket, preload, remote-denial and guarded action tests passed with synthetic collaborators; plan/server tests and 200 remote protocol unit tests passed. Live provider execution and full-check verification remain pending.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
